reactome_pathway_separation.summary: Reactome enrichment across the 42-gene panel separates canonical mitotic cell-cycle execution (R-HSA-69278, R-HSA-453279, R-HSA-1538133, R-HSA-68886) from E2F6/DREAM chromatin repression (R-HSA-8953750, R-HSA-1362277), homologous recombination / checkpoint control (R-HSA-75035, R-HSA-5693532), RTK oncogenic signaling (R-HSA-1227990, R-HSA-1643713), and oncogene-induced senescence (R-HSA-2559585).

string_subspace_coupling_network.summary: Physical and functional PPI bridges (taxon 9606) connecting the 5 core mitotic clock controls (CCNB1, TOP2A, MKI67, PCNA, CDK1) to the 37 proliferation-coupled lineage, repair, chromatin, and amplicon drivers, explaining why ordinary least-squares (OLS) cell-cycle regression (regress_out) suffers severe projection leakage.

transcriptional_regulation_jaspar_unibin.summary: Direct TF-DNA ChIP-seq binding datasets (UniBind) and Position Weight Matrices (JASPAR CORE Taxon 9606) demonstrating how S/G2M cell-cycle regulators (E2F1, E2F4, FOXM1, MYC) and lineage/checkpoint TFs (SOX2, TP53, STAT3) co-regulate replication-coupled chromatin, DNA repair, and stemness programs.

literature_citations_europepmc.summary: Peer-reviewed benchmark studies demonstrating that linear/OLS cell-cycle regression (Scanpy regress_out / Seurat ScaleData vars.to.regress) erases biological fate, neural progenitor differentiation, and tumor proliferation-coupled plasticity.
